editorial:
You follow Hudson Milbank, a successful Hollywood screenwriter who suddenly stops feeling anything at all. He tries doctors, shrinks, pills, and odd routines like watching the Golf Channel or joining lesbian exercise classes, but nothing fixes his numbness. His writing partner pushes him to get back to normal, yet the real spark comes when he meets Sara. The movie mixes awkward comedy with a softer romantic side, so you get laughs and a little heart without feeling too heavy.

The acting keeps the strange setup grounded, and the pacing stays easy to follow even when the jokes get weird. Some scenes are funny, while others feel a bit uneven, but the romance gives the story a clear goal. If you like quirky romantic comedies with an offbeat hero, this is a fun pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Hudson realizes that Sara is the person who helps him feel again. After struggling through doctors, pills, and strange habits, he finally connects with her in a real and honest way. The movie ends on a hopeful note, showing that love and human connection can break through his emotional numbness, even if his recovery is not perfect or complete.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves offbeat romantic comedies with an unusual hero.
